method: Compare distinct Crossref journal articles by exact publication date, the public APS Harvest article listing paged via Link headers, and the normal CrossrefAdapter output for each disjoint week. Verify every accepted DOI, date and CC BY version-of-record license against the publisher. Compare publisher-declared arXiv identifiers against the Crossref relation and resolve the arXiv API identifiers to their original submission date and subject tags. The publisher listing covered a subset of Crossref deposits. A missing preprint relation leaves preprint status unknown. Lag, subject coverage and counts for publisher-linked versions apply only to that subset.
